learner_facing_text: This awareness course authorizes no connection, disconnection, energization, testing, repair, protection change, grounding or bonding decision, service work, generator tie-in, or temporary-distribution design.
notes: Crew Blueprint boundary intentionally narrower than the full range of work a qualified/authorized electrical worker may perform. It is not presented as verbatim regulatory language.

lesson_identifier: Keep Awareness, Competence, Credentials & Authorization Separate
learner_facing_text: ETCP distinguishes Portable Power Distribution Technician from the broader Entertainment Electrician scope and bases certification eligibility substantially on documented experience, with other qualifying pathways also recognized.
notes: Rephrased from current learner copy to avoid implying work experience is the only eligibility path.

lesson_identifier: Keep Awareness, Competence, Credentials & Authorization Separate
learner_facing_text: Course completion is not electrical qualification or job authorization; any later technical work depends on task-specific training, demonstrated competence, supervision/authorization and applicable employer, venue, equipment and legal requirements.
notes: Synthesis boundary. OSHA qualified-person status is workplace/task dependent; ETCP certification is a separate credential layer.

learner_facing_text: An Electrics Lead title or Crew Blueprint course completion does not by itself establish qualified-person status, employer appointment, local licensure, venue acceptance or AHJ authority.
notes: Normalizes the broader existing course boundary into separately auditable authority states.

learner_facing_text: ETCP defines Entertainment Electrician as the broader electrical certification scope and Portable Power Distribution Technician as a narrower portable-power-distribution scope.
notes: Credential scope does not supersede employer, venue, licensing or AHJ requirements.

learner_facing_text: Restricted electrical work and required electrical verification must remain with people who are qualified and authorized for the actual task and installation; the course teaches coordination and evidence of readiness, not live-power procedure.
notes: Uses qualified/authorized as separate concepts. Exact legal scope varies by task, installation and jurisdiction.

learner_facing_text: Advanced load-planning literacy remains conceptual/documentation learning; it does not establish qualified-person status or authorize energized work, connection, testing or acceptance of a real electrical system.
notes: Preserves the existing advanced-course boundary while separating knowledge depth from authority.
